description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) and Condition 4 (materials) attached to planning permission PL/3129/25 dated 12.2.2026 to increase to the previously approved single storey rear extension and include skylights within the flat roof; aluminium windows and doors (Amended Description and Plan)
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission PL/3129/25 dated 12-02-2026.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building the approved plans.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>Notwithstanding Condition 4 of this permission, no development shall take place until details of soft landscaping to the forecourt of Brakelond have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, including a programme of implementation and maintenance; and the development shall be carried out and the soft landscaping maintained in accordance with the details and programme approved&nbsp;</p>

This permission shall have the effect of varying condition numbered 2 on approved application reference&nbsp;PL/3129/25&nbsp;dated&nbsp;12-02-2026. The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Planning Cover Letter, Heritage Statement [01/12/2025]; Reasonable Exemption Statement; 1114/P/1A, 1114/P/2, 1114/P/3B
